description: Redesign the Project Shell, Overview, and Analytics pages with modern UI/UX. Improve the ProjectHeaderBar with a more polished breadcrumb and environment switcher. Enhance the Overview page with better data visualization, card compositions, and scannable metrics. Modernize the Analytics page with improved chart interactions and layout.
steps: Redesign src/modules/projects/components/ProjectHeaderBar.tsx: (a) Make the header more compact with better use of space. (b) Improve the environment selector with a colored indicator dot that's more prominent. (c) Add a subtle animated status indicator for active projects. (d) Improve breadcrumb with better visual separation and hover states.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectOverviewPage.tsx: (a) Improve the stat cards row with mini sparkline trends in each card and better color coding. (b) Redesign the HourlyBars chart component with better tooltip interactions, gradient fills, and a smoother visual style. (c) Improve the Breakdown component with animated progress bars and better labeling. (d) Redesign the configuration snapshot section with a more visual toggle grid instead of plain pills. (e) Add a 'Quick actions' card with contextual shortcuts based on project state. (f) Better visual grouping with section dividers or subtle background variations.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectAnalyticsPage.tsx: (a) Improve the VolumeChart SVG component with hover crosshair, tooltip showing exact values, and smoother line rendering. (b) Redesign the HeatmapGrid with better color scaling and cell hover states. (c) Add a sticky toolbar that remains visible while scrolling through analytics sections. (d) Improve the comparison table with inline bar visualizations. (e) Better skeleton loading states matching content shape.
Follow all rules.md constraints and use existing shared primitives.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectHeaderBar has improved breadcrumbs, environment selector, and status indicator
ProjectOverviewPage renders with improved stat cards, chart visualizations, and configuration display
ProjectAnalyticsPage has improved chart interactions and heatmap styling
All changes use theme tokens only - no hardcoded colors
npm run build completes without new TypeScript errors
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it passes without new errors
